prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: review-only modular character anatomy/style board for Caelum Argenteum, issue #736 under #458. This is concept artwork, not evidence of a native 3D model.
Primary request: one clean landscape comparison board showing exactly six full-body standing adult figures of BEAST MAN - BEAR. Top row: same adult male in FRONT, PROFILE, BACK. Bottom row: same adult female in FRONT, PROFILE, BACK. Orthographic-like views, identical scale within each row, full heads and soles visible, relaxed neutral stance with arms slightly away from the torso. Believable anatomy and joints, ordinary capable physiques, no exaggerated superhero or childlike proportions.
Style and presentation: closely match reference image 1's polished restrained 3D character concept rendering, plain light gray studio background, soft neutral light, fine cloth/leather textures and clear consistent view layout. Image 1 is only the proposed human board for shared clothing/material/lighting/layout; it must not erase the species anatomy in the other references.
Clothing: male and female wear the same practical plain ivory/cream long-sleeved lace-collar shirt, loose dark charcoal trousers, simple brown leather belt, separate brown leather gloves and calf boots as image 1. Fully covering, modest fit. Each garment must read as a separate removable layer; hair, if applicable, is not built into the shirt. No armor, cape, scarf, jewelry, weapons, shields, new accessories or environment. No numeric heights or gameplay claims.
Species requirements: Use the owned bear head atlas in image 2 as the anatomy/color authority: full broad bear skull, small round ears, broad bear muzzle, dark brown fur and lighter muzzle, amber-brown eyes. Both sexes have a complete animal head, not a human face in a furry mask; no human hairstyles, makeup, horns or accessories. Adult biped body silhouettes with a naturally substantial chest and shoulders under the same clothes, female distinct but sturdy and practical rather than slender human with animal ears. The head/neck connection must be broad enough to be credible. No tail is proposed in this board; do not imply numeric height, strength or gameplay rules. No claws projecting through closed gloves/boots.
Layout and exact text: title "BEAST MAN - BEAR / STYLE PROPOSAL"; subtitle "Concept only - pending author review"; row labels "MALE" and "FEMALE"; each row's column labels "FRONT", "PROFILE", "BACK". No other text. Generous spacing, crisp detail, no clipped body parts. Preserve each individual, clothing, color, head shape and hairstyle across its three views.
